tools.description: Keyword search over concepts; returns IDs, best first (all terms preferred, then OR fallback). Default 8 hits; related: N adds the neighbourhood of the hits. Glossary aliases match too (expanded_to). scope is a map name or id prefix, never a KB name.
tools.name: search

tools.description: Reads a concept: content_hash, frontmatter (parsed; frontmatter_raw only if it does not parse), body. with_content: true returns content (exact bytes) instead of body. section returns one section; outline: true only the headings; match greps lines.

full.description: Body over 60 KB comes as outline; true forces it

rev.description: Past version SHA (concept_history); its hash is no if_match

tools.name: concept_read

tools.description: Reads a folder's index.md (root if empty). with_hash: {path, content, content_hash} (if_match for index_patch). Over 60 KB: outline, unless full or with_hash; outline: true forces it.
tools.name: index_get

tools.description: The concepts around a question or given concepts, ranked over links both ways: one call instead of chaining search, concept_read and graph_neighbors.
tools.name: graph_context

tools.description: Graph neighbors up to depth hops (default 1): out = linked from the concept, in = linking to it, both = either.
tools.name: graph_neighbors

tools.description: Exhaustive inventory (id, title, type, status; fields adds keys, content_hash too) under a scope prefix, sorted by id; empty = whole KB. where and timestamp filters apply before limit. For curated navigation use index_get.

where.description: ANDed frontmatter key=value or key!=value; list fields match any element; case-sensitive; a missing key matches != only

tools.name: concept_list

tools.description: Root index.md plus the Maps and Journals with concept counts. structure: true adds the most central concepts and link-graph communities: where to start reading. How to work in this KB: kb_guide.
tools.name: atlas_overview

tools.description: Reads a KB-root artifact (skills/, agents/, hooks/, mcp/, instructions.md, templates/<slug>.md, paths.yaml, glossary.yaml). Returns content and sha256, the if_match for artifact_write/artifact_delete.
tools.name: artifact_read

tools.description: How to work in this KB: the operating guide, the procedures available and, if you may see them, the KB's own skills. Call it first if you were given no instructions. procedure (ingest, conflict-resolve, import) returns its steps; file reads a references/ file of that procedure. Read-only.
tools.name: kb_guide
